def read(p): return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def write(p,d):
 p=Path(p);p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);q=p.with_suffix(p.suffix+'.tmp');q.write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n');q.replace(p)
def fp(p):
 p=Path(p);p=p if p.is_absolute() else ROOT/p
 with p.open('rb') as f: sha=hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
 return {'path':str(p.relative_to(ROOT)) if p.is_relative_to(ROOT) else str(p),'sha256':sha,'size':p.stat().st_size}
def check(r):
 a=fp(r['path']);assert a['sha256']==r['sha256'] and a['size']==r.get('size',r.get('bytes',a['size'])),r['path']
def source(p):
 p=Path(p).resolve();out=BT/'docs'/('adapter-'+p.stem+'.json');d={'source':fp(p),'source_text':p.read_text(),'purpose':'Exact task-local source; remove executable after use.'}
 if out.exists(): assert read(out)==d
 else:write(out,d)
def harness(action,event=None):
 cmd=[sys.executable,str(ROOT/'backtest/scripts/maintenance/experiment_harness.py'),action,'--state',str(STATE)]
 if event is not None:
  path=BT/'docs'/f'native-event-{read(STATE)["revision"]+1}.json';write(path,event);cmd+=['--event',str(path),'--expected-revision',str(read(STATE)['revision'])]
 r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stdout+r.stderr
 return json.loads(r.stdout)
